Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the Orchestrator instructed WebSurfer to check the websites of Whole Foods Market, Trader Joe's, and Mariano's. WebSurfer clicked the "website" link from the search results but landed on `https://www.wholefoodsmarket.co.uk/` (the UK version) instead of the US site. This prevented the agent from verifying salad prices for the Chicago location. Furthermore, when instructed to check Trader Joe's and Mariano's later, WebSurfer failed to navigate to those specific sites to check prices; instead, it got stuck on the Trader Joe's homepage and then searched for Mariano's prices on Bing/Instacart without explicitly confirming the price point ($ under $15) on the site itself before the final summary was generated. The critical failure was navigating to the wrong regional website (UK vs US) for the first store, which invalidates the data gathering for that specific location.
